statement:
Before I act, let me look up the access record for G-19.
The record gives **"restricted access only"** for consent — which conflicts with the "open, cleared for publication" access level, but the participants' consent restriction must take precedence.

Since the consent is restricted access only, I cannot publish this file. I will instead set it to **hold**.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "open, cleared for publication" access level conflicts with restricted consent and concludes "I cannot publish this file," identifying the specific defective value.
